text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the adab of dealing with others, such as not mocking or harming them. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'A Muslim is the brother of another Muslim; he does not wrong him nor surrender him' (Sahih al-Bukhari 2442). He also urged tolerance and avoiding anger. These values help build healthy relationships.
